chunks: Al-Mu‘allā ibn Khunays asked Abā ‘Abdillāh عليه السلام about salat on al-qufr and al-qīr.
So he said: “There is no issue with it.”

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ: there is no problem with it; it is permissible

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform salat on al-qufr and al-qīr according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith records a legal question posed to Imam Ja‘far ibn Muḥammad al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام regarding performing salat on al-qufr and al-qīr. The Imam’s reply indicates permissibility, making the report relevant to rulings on what may be used or stood upon in prayer.
